summary: Frontend UI merge verification for the new consolidated 'Price & Market Intel' tab (IntelPage) as super_admin (a.disi@taqueen.sa). Executed a comprehensive Playwright test covering sidebar wiring, KPI band, banners, market row, leaderboard, action row, op-tabs, date-range controls, digest modal, and backward compatibility. ALL 20+ acceptance criteria from the review request passed. Zero JS console errors, 0.51s load time (well under 6s), no NaN/undefined/[object Object] leaks. Market Position card is not rendered because the preview DB has zero ranked_products (documented data-seed limitation, not a code bug — the card is conditionally rendered by design when ranked_products > 0).
critical_code_review_comments: IntelPage.jsx is 552 lines — still under the 700-line guideline, but nearing it. Extracting Row 4 (Market Position card block), Row 5 (Revenue Leaderboard), and Row 6 (Confidence/PriceWars/Restock) into small sub-components would improve maintainability.
Sidebar `pageKeys` (array) support is a nice generalisation; consider unifying with the existing `pageKey` single-key path by always normalising to an array internally.

Market Position card is hidden entirely when ranked_products === 0. Consider rendering an empty state (data-testid still present) instead of unmounting — this would make QA and future data-seed changes safer, and matches the pattern already used for other cards (no_data placeholder).
context_for_next_testing_agent: IntelPage merge is fully working. If you need to verify the Market Position card visually, seed the preview DB with at least one product having competitor rankings (m.ranked_products > 0) or test against production. The card is intentionally unmounted when no products are ranked. Both /insights and /price-intel routes mount IntelPage. Sidebar shows only 'Price & Market Intel' (data-testid='nav-nav_intel'); old nav_insights and nav_priceintel are fully removed. All 5 op-tabs (action/advantage/full/unverified/gaps) render PriceIntelTabContent cleanly with 0 console errors. Date-range pills (7/14/30/90), custom date range + clear, digest modal, and tile-click navigation to /?market_filter=... all wired correctly.

detailed_results.kpi_band_order_matches_spec: my_skus, matched, drops, gaps, confidence — CORRECT
detailed_results.market_position_card: NOT RENDERED — ranked_products=0 in preview DB (documented data-seed limitation, conditional render by design)
